title: 631. N-ary Tree Preorder Traversal

examples.explanation: Visit the root, then each child subtree left to right.
Depth-first order follows child order at every node.

hints: Rebuild the tree from the bracket string: each null-terminated group belongs to the next queued node.
Walk depth-first, emitting a node before its children.
An empty input yields an empty list.
Adaptation: the N-ary Node input is encoded as a level-order string; output maps to int_list.
